exposure: women without ultrasound features of adenomyosis (controls)
women with ultrasound features of adenomyosis
outcome: presence of hypoechoic striation of myometrium
cohort: 58 premenopausal women attending a university hospital outpatient service for contraception, with 38 having ultrasound features of adenomyosis and 20 without
finding: Dienogest-based hormonal contraceptives improved sonographic features of adenomyosis (reduced uterine volume, eliminated hypoechoic striation and cysts, decreased anterior/posterior wall ratio) and reduced menstrual pain and days of menstrual flow in women with and without adenomyosis.
